notes: SBV changed M2/deposit methodology from the Oct-2025 reporting period (sector reclassification; M2 excludes valuable papers bought by other domestic CIs). Jan-Sep 2025 and Oct-2025+ levels are NOT comparable; m2_ytd/deposits_ytd for Oct-Dec 2025 left null; M2 YoY null throughout (no comparable prior-year base). Dec-2025 m2_ytd = 15.7% is SBV-reported annual growth via press.

SBV monthly statistics pages (sbv.gov.vn) only expose Jan-2025 onward after the 2025 site migration; Oct-Dec 2024 monthly levels for M2 are not available (null). Dec-2024 deposits from press quoting SBV; Dec-2024 credit level derived from SBV Jan-2025 level/YTD.
Latest SBV statistical tables at fetch (2026-10-05): M2/deposits Jul-2026, credit by sector Jul-2026; Aug/Sep-2026 credit from SBV press conference statements (approximate levels).

Annual m2: 2015-2022 from World Bank WDI (IMF IFS broad money); 2024-2025 SBV 'tổng phương tiện thanh toán' — different definitions (SBV series includes valuable papers); 2023 null. Treat as a series break.

Annual deposits use IMF FSI 'customer deposits' of deposit takers (consistent 2015-2025); SBV-reported 'huy động vốn' growth used for deposit_growth where available (2015, 2021-2025), else computed from FSI (see sources.deposit_growth_by_year).

Annual credit growth: SBV final figures where found (2016-2019, 2023-2025); 2020-2022 rounded values from Saigon Times; 2015 is SBV's ~18% estimate (17.17% at 21/12/2015). 2022 SBV year-end estimate was 14.5%.
M0 and M1: SBV does not publish them; IMF MFS dataflows on api.imf.org return no Vietnam data; tradingeconomics blocked (403). Only cash/M2 ratio is available (monthly cash_to_m2_pct).
ROA/ROE in SBV tables are cumulative YTD figures for the period in the table (not annualised); IMF FSI annual ROA/ROE are full-year (2023 negative due to SCB).
CAR: SBV stopped publishing a whole-system CAR in 2020 (split into Basel II/TT41 group and TT22 group); use IMF FSI regulatory capital/RWA for the system.
NPL definitions differ: SBV on-balance whole-system (~3.3-4.1%), excl. 5 weak/special-control banks (~1.5-1.7%), incl. VAMC & potential (~3.8-4.0%); IMF FSI NPL 2025 = 4.21%.
Real-estate credit: SBV total RE credit (incl. home loans) vs MoC 'real-estate business' credit are different aggregates.
